When on break, make sure not to doomscroll, read the coments (hey!) or play video games because that doesn't help your brain rest. Instead, do either:
🡒 Box breathing! 
    ↳ Breath in for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four, and repeat. 
    ↳ Don't worry about loosing your focus, thats normal and okay. Just recentre yourself, it"s part of the process.
🡒 Sketch patterns! 
    ↳ Don't draw pictures, just whatever patterns come to mind, like lines, triangles, rectangles, circles, and shading like hatching. Don't draw a cat, etc.
🡒 Stare at a wall and be mindful. 
    ↳ Maybe hold an ice cube?

Also drink water and go to the bathroom if you need too :D

    ↳ Breath in for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four, and repeat. 
    ↳ Don't worry about loosing your focus, thats normal and okay. Just recentre yourself, it"s part of the process.
🡒 Sketch patterns! 
    ↳ Don't draw pictures, just whatever patterns come to mind, like lines, triangles, rectangles, circles, and shading like hatching. Don't draw a cat, etc.
🡒 Stare at a wall and be mindful. 
    ↳ Maybe hold an ice cube?

Also drink water and go to the bathroom if you need too :D
